import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic

structure FlowState where
  u : Flow3D
  ω : Vorticity3D
  helicity : ℝ
  h_pos : helicity > 0

def Enstrophy (ω : Vorticity3D) : ℝ := sorry

theorem navier_stokes_helical_regularity
  (s : FlowState) (T : ℝ) (h_bkm : Integrable (VorticityLInfty s.ω) 0 T) :
  NoBlowUp s.u T :=
by
  have h_attr : Enstrophy s.ω ≤ (Real.log 10) ^ 2 := by sorry
  exact bkm_regularity_closure s.h_pos h_attr h_bkm
